programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: 不了情
programme.desc: 歌女青青与建筑师汤鹏南原是一对感情深厚的情侣，可惜好景不常，汤家突遭巨变，青青不惜出卖自己肉体以相助鹏南，想不到竟被鹏南误会而导致俩人分手。后来鹏南得知事情始末，欲挽回感情，可惜青青已患上绝症。

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: 洪文定三破白莲教
programme.desc: 白莲教主六十余岁，红颜白发，练就绝招，能闭全身穴道，武功高深莫测，却甘作满清鹰犬，暗中协助师侄高进忠，消灭反清志士及破坏重建少林寺；洪文定为少林英雄洪熙官之子，曾击毙白之师弟白眉道人，名震江湖。白与高侦知洪住反清志士胡亚彪家中，夜袭杀胡及其妹，洪幸护着身怀六甲的胡妻突围逃走...

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: 花街时代
programme.desc: 少女美丽为谋生来到湾仔酒吧当吧女，自此沦落风尘。其后，美丽在酒吧认识占美，深深爱上他，并确定自己已找到真爱。当占美要离开的时候，伤心的美丽即陷入低潮，直到遇上黑帮头目王英才有了倚靠。

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit…

programme.title: 无翼蝙蝠
programme.desc: 失踪五年的无翼蝙蝠，忽然重出江湖，奸淫少女。风流大侠萧七与总镖头雷迅追查真相，并发现无翼蝙蝠可能被嫁祸。传说无翼蝙蝠的蝙蝠刀内藏有蝙蝠宝图，于是他们将计就计，借刀引出幕后真凶…

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

programme.title: 双凤奇缘
programme.desc: 秦凤笙、凤箫兄妹才情敏捷，满腹经纶，却常受继母夏氏刻薄。凤箫自幼许与李如龙为妻，夏氏贪图富贵，强逼如龙退婚；如龙不肯，夏氏再施毒计诬告如龙偷盗，将其收在狱中。凤箫为救如龙，与侍婢春兰乔扮男装上京，更以如龙之名赴考，一举中恩科状元。明世宗见凤箫长得一表非凡，乃命相国为媒，招为驸马。洞房之夕，凤箫向公主言明真相，并说服公主，安排一条妙计…

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: 布衣神相
programme.desc: 东瀛甲派忍者血洗武当，并命人污蔑于无敌门掌门独孤无敌。云飞扬练成天蚕神功后，决意为武当报仇，挑战独孤无敌，但却被打败至重伤。幸得布衣神相李布衣所助，伤患得以复原，才能逃避忍者的追杀。

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: 女儿国
programme.desc: 本片讲述唐僧、孙悟空、猪八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取经，行至西梁女儿国，国内全是女人，而传宗接代生儿育女全靠「招胎泉」，饮过这泉水便可成孕，但也只能生女。

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: 火并
programme.desc: 大同府著名银号福来钱庄，内储黄金逾百万两，使各方贼寇垂涎。独脚大盗滕奇影本欲邀钱庄护院文礼贤合谋，将钱庄金银据为己有，但文严拒；滕转向白氏姐妹玉燕及玉莺着手，共襄劫金大举……

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: 寒烟翠
programme.desc: 陈咏薇的父母准备离异，于是把她送到章家暂住。章家长子凌霄、次子凌风、三女凌云和年轻画家余亚南都对咏薇很好，使她在章家农场度过了难忘的暑假。

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: 侠士行
programme.desc: 严太师遇刺毙命，护卫范义追击刺客至穷巷，见他踏镖逾墙逸去，而镖乃寇英之器，范遂遍城贴满通缉寇的画像。寇取得遇害县官宋化龙身上的公文，得以入城，却仍为范捉拿，幸得酒店店主的女儿雪娘，自认寇是其表哥，寇才幸免被捕；寇向雪道出自己的身份及真相。其后，范遭假扮成寇的寨主贺西雷袭击，而救回他的竟是……

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: 大杀手
programme.desc: 结义兄弟妹三人同闯江湖情意深，龙兄加入了缉私队，虎弟率直被人利用，小妹夹在中间做人难。

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly “Iron Fist” technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: 天下第一拳
programme.desc: 故事描述，顾文宗饰的老拳师突遭百武馆馆徒袭击，幸汪萍饰的女儿及罗烈饰的弟子救驾；顾自知年迈力衰，不足为罗师，亦恐邪派夺全国锦标，遂面谕罗改投尚武馆习艺，以夺魁为期许。罗途遇王金凤饰的卖唱女遭调戏，王获救后欲以身相许，罗心中有汪遂拒王；后罗屡遭百武馆徒滋扰，更为外援日本浪人所伤...

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: 红楼梦
programme.desc: 这部电影改编自中国史上最广受欢迎的文学作品《红楼梦》，被誉为同名电影中最成功的作品。乐蒂生动地诠释了美丽却带有一丝哀愁的林黛玉角色，也因此赢得了「古典美人」的美誉。

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancée enlists a swordsman—who secretly loves her—to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: 断肠剑
programme.desc: 李岳为报父仇暗杀高官后遭通缉，隐姓埋名成为逃犯。他的未婚妻贞儿委托暗恋她的剑客方君兆寻找爱郎，却不知女盗贼小眉早已对李岳暗生情愫。他们错综复杂的爱情四角关系展现出无悔的割舍、付出与无私而伟大的情感。

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: 故都春梦
programme.desc: 故事源自脍炙人口的《啼笑因缘》，内容描述民国初年，富家子范嘉恕恋上歌女岑逢仙，同时又唯卖艺少女官绣珠及貌似岑的财政厅长女儿贺莉霞所迷恋。张大帅垂涎岑，更奸污了她。嘉恕后得绣珠相助，才从大帅手中救回爱人。

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: 茅山天师
programme.desc: 赤练君在押解过程中逃脱，张道长亦因此被逐出师门。为追查赤炼君的下落，张道长来到一个地方，发现有很多平民无故失踪。当张道长查出赤练君为练成蛇魔而抓走平民后，一场人魔大战旋即展开。

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: 虚拟特攻
programme.desc: 金牌保镖龙威在妻子惨死后患上了创伤后应激障碍，心情低落。他意外结识高科技公司职员Amy，在她邀请下参加了新产品的虚拟测试。龙威测试成功后即成为该公司的虚拟特攻，更获试用新发明的防护机甲，不料遭遇神秘武装人员入侵，一场生死大战即将展开…

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: 情圣
programme.desc: 终日偷呃拐骗的程胜被贵利王所迫，要与女骗子叶圆合谋洗劫一间豪华大宅。不料却遇上另一群骗子冒充豪宅屋主去偷取屋内的古董，程胜和叶圆唯有扮成到访的阔少和太太。当他们发现对方的真正身份后，决定一起设骗局对付贵利王。

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora’s Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: 西游记大结局之仙履奇缘
programme.desc: 在月光宝盒引发的混乱之后，至尊宝被卷入时空之中，并逐渐觉醒为孙悟空的真实身份。在凡人情感与天命之间不断拉扯，他努力在对紫霞仙子的爱情与肩负的使命之间作出艰难抉择。

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: 火云邪神之修罗面具
programme.desc: 十八年前，邪恶的黑羽会潜入了老邪神西城勇的地盘，盗走了修罗面具，而利用修罗面具放出当时只是个婴儿的魔神。老邪神为了魔神日后不作恶收养了婴儿，教他好好做人，成为小邪神。小邪神最后控制了面具的力量成为老邪神的接班人，继续守护城市。

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: 柠檬可乐
programme.desc: 就读女校高中的婷婷，因排演《罗密欧与茱丽叶》而与邻校男生Jackson戏假情真，爱情就在排练时萌芽。这是婷婷的初恋，但Jaskson却是一个变幻莫测的爱情玩家…

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: 冰封侠之时空行者
programme.desc: 《冰封侠：时空行者》承接前作，四位明朝锦衣卫在现代香港苏醒。为修正历史，贺英独自踏上了寻找「时空金球」的凶险旅程，却不知自己正一步步堕入精心布下的致命陷阱。

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: 让子弹飞
programme.desc: 悍匪张牧之劫持火车，冒充新任县长强横进驻鹅城。本想靠升官发财大捞一笔，却撞上了只手遮天的当地地头蛇恶霸黄四郎。在满嘴谎言的骗子师爷马邦德的利益周旋下，黑白两道展开一场智力与火力的巅峰对决。在这场荒诞的杀戮游戏中，且看子弹如何飞往最终的真相。

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: 爱的世界
programme.desc: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命。妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离。与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生…

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: 军火大劫案
programme.desc: 特工阿文被安排潜伏于东南亚的军火商旗下，寻找其手中的一批军火炸药并将其销毁。当他终于找到该批军火后，却遭到不明匪徒袭击。为防止灾难发生，阿文决定与他的特工搭档阿琼合力夺回军火。

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: 青木劫
programme.desc: 民国初年，富甲一方的康氏惨遭灭门，唯一的目击证人—家中的幼女—在亲眼目睹全家被杀后离奇失踪。几十年间，位于青木巷的废弃康宅充斥着灵异惊悚的气氛。随着真相逐渐揭露，这个恐怖的疑团交织着复仇与死亡的动机。

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: 风雨同路
programme.desc: 卧底探员张郎奉命接近前黑帮大哥李云飞，调查冷血匪帮首领大傻所涉及的钻石劫案，并借机套取线报。当交易出现意外后，钻石落入李云飞手中，大傻决心将两人置于死地。张郎与李云飞被迫联手反击。

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: 关云长
programme.desc: 这是一场发生在三国动荡时期的史诗式之旅。曹操试图招揽关羽加入他的阵营，但关羽忠于他的结拜兄弟刘备，也是曹操的敌人。当关羽试图从曹操手上救出刘备的小妾时，迫于无奈要大开杀戒。最后他能否杀出重围？

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: 画皮
programme.desc: 书生王怀卿卖画，为要筹药费救患重病的妻子，途中意外遇上雀妖的追击，幸得狐妖小容相救。为躲避雀妖，王怀卿将小容带回家中，三人随即陷入一场情感困局，而一段凄美的人妖虐恋亦随即展开。

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: 武松斗杀西门庆
programme.desc: 豪杰武松因揭发嫂子潘金莲与西门庆的奸情而遭陷害，被迫刺配流放。当得知兄长武大郎惨遭毒杀后，武松悲愤回乡讨回公道，却发现官府贪赃枉法，拒绝严惩真凶。面对黑白颠倒的世道，怒火中烧的武松决意血战狮子楼，亲手向仇人展开复仇。

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: 白蛇传说
programme.desc: 这部奇幻动作片改编自中国经典传说《白蛇传》，讲述郎中许仙爱上化身为女子的千年白蛇。白蛇的真实身份被揭露后，高僧法海为守护人类与超自然力量之间的平衡，不得不挺身而出，展开一场惊心动魄的对决。

programme.title: Inheritors
programme.desc: Inheritors is a multi-media product from CGTN that shines a light on China’s rich Intangible Cultural Heritage. Each 30-minute TV edition is hosted by a long-term expatriate in China who has a unique understanding of the country’s culture. He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

programme.title: Lady Sour
programme.desc: CHO CHING (Myolie Wu) and her mother CHO CHO BAI-YUET (Gigi Wong) lead vagrant lives by practicing medicine everywhere, during which they get to know KAI CHUN (Ron Ng), a man with a skin disease, and their fellow villager, CHIN TUNG (Him Law), respectively. Falling in love with CHIN TUNG at first sight, CHO CHING tries by all means to marry him, unfortunately, the matriarch of the vinegar brewery, CHIN SHEUNG (Alice Chan), thwarts her plan at all costs, because she is still nursing a grudge aga

programme.title: 醋娘子
programme.desc: 曹青(胡杏儿)与母亲曹曹闭月(黄淑仪)结伴行医跑江湖，先后认识了患皮肤病的计准(吴卓羲)和同乡钱通(罗仲谦)，曹青对钱通一见钟情，千方百计嫁入钱家，可惜醋坊当家钱霜(陈炜)因与闭月有积怨对曹青百般阻挠，计准因病治愈献计助曹青得偿所愿，曹青入门后以为一劳永逸，谁料钱通深爱丫环山楂(岑丽香)，曹青乘机搞乱，反令山楂和钱通意外发生关系，钱通纳山楂为妾，令曹青醋意大发，火上加油。突然，一具尸骸被发现，闭月被告谋害亲夫判处死刑，钱家怕名声受损，要求曹青与闭月断绝母女关系，此际，曹青竟发现有「喜」，却惹来一场休妻大行动......

programme.desc: Ever since his childhood, KO TIN-PO (Wong Cho Lam) has tasted a variety of great delicacies, and he is capable of analyzing the food quality and authenticity once he tastes it. But, owing to the decline of his family, he ends up wandering on the street with his servant LEE WAI (Jack Wu), making a living from selling buns. programme.title: 食为奴
programme.desc: 高天宝(王祖蓝)自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫(胡诺言)流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪(万绮雯)、京城第一美女年若碧(胡定欣)、少女厨神米小鱼(何雁诗)等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛(黄智贤)，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭(林盛斌)，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩(张继聪)策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗......

programme.title: The Offliners
programme.desc: In Hong Kong, investing in finance, real estate and commerce are down-to-earth activities, but rich heiress WONG CHI-FEI (Katy Kung) prefers getting her head in the clouds, cofounding a start-up technology company with her best friend HUI CHING-WAI (Jason Chan). A network hacking incident allows CHI-FEI to have a chance to know how capable IT genius DING SHUN-HEI (Owen Cheung) is, so she invites him to join the company. SHUN-HEI is a geek and oblivious of his surroundings. He gets help from a nu

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫......子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.title: Heart And Greed
programme.desc: LING LAI-YING (Louise Lee) and her husband WONG WING-CHING (Ha Yu) work hard to run their restaurant, eventually turning it into an entrepreneurial success involving real estate investing and business. LAI-YING's younger brother LING SHING-FUNG (Bosco Wong) even tries to help them get the company listed on the stock market. Initially, WING-CHING does not agree with this. After seeing the century old family print business run by his benefactor HUI NGA-LUN (Joseph Lee), who helped him get acquitte

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴......

programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融、地产、商业是「贴地」举动，富二代王子菲(龚嘉欣饰)却偏爱「离地」，与好友许正伟(陈智燊饰)开设初创科技公司。一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希(张振朗饰)的厉害，邀他加入公司。信希是一名「离地」毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱(刘佩钥饰)帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫......子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤(李国麟饰)、弟王梓龙(罗梓龙饰)、信希之妹丁信恩(黄心颖饰)身上！

programme.title: 溏心风暴3
programme.desc: 凌丽荧(李司棋)与丈夫黄永正(夏雨)凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风(黄宗泽)更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟(李国麟)助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华(关菊英)及亲弟梁赞(阮兆祥)大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧(米雪)有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议。可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家(王浩信)与许家独生女许贝儿(岑丽香)相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱(陈敏之)与有妇之夫郑立安(唐文龙)的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文(黄翠如)关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴......

programme.title: 醋娘子
programme.desc: 曹青(胡杏儿)与母亲曹曹闭月(黄淑仪)结伴行医跑江湖，先后认识了患皮肤病的计准(吴卓羲)和同乡钱通(罗仲谦)，曹青对钱通一见钟情，千方百计嫁入钱家，可惜醋坊当家钱霜(陈炜)因与闭月有积怨对曹青百般阻挠，计准因病治愈献计助曹青得偿所愿，曹青入门后以为一劳永逸，谁料钱通深爱丫环山楂(岑丽香)，曹青乘机搞乱，反令山楂和钱通意外发生关系，钱通纳山楂为妾，令曹青醋意大发，火上加油。突然，一具尸骸被发现，闭月被告谋害亲夫判处死刑，钱家怕名声受损，要求曹青与闭月断绝母女关系，此际，曹青竟发现有「喜」，却惹来一场休妻大行动......
